name: issue-atlas
description: Explore GitHub issue dependencies as an interactive directed graph inside VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Use GitHub CLI when it is installed and signed in; otherwise sign in with your VS Code GitHub account.
Always use GitHub CLI. Requests run through `gh api graphql`, so Issue Atlas never handles a token.
Always use the GitHub account signed in to VS Code.
issueAtlas.authentication.provider.markdownDescription: How Issue Atlas authenticates its read-only GitHub GraphQL requests. No personal access token is needed.

issueAtlas.githubCli.path.markdownDescription: The GitHub CLI executable. Use an absolute path when `gh` is not on the `PATH` that VS Code inherits.
